title: World Commerce Corporation / Maynard Corporation international cabal

tellings.quote: He places that in the World Commerce Corporation, which is this Caribbean constellation of shell sort of companies.

plain: A network of businesses called the World Commerce Corporation, linked to another called the Maynard Corporation, worked as a secret international group, according to Michels, who calls it "this Caribbean constellation of shell sort of companies." He tells this himself, crediting the book Secret Machines, while talking with a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown, and ties the network to a man named Otto Scorzani. If true, it would point to a hidden private web behind secret programs.
